prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the two silicone container from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are placed on material station in the following order: a green-marked silicone container on the left, immediately followed by a blue-marked silicone container.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A laboratory bench holds tiered metal rails fitted with white labelled position markers, purple/white printed labels and black-and-white fiducial (QR-style) code stickers.

On the left, black racks hold rows of centrifuge/sample tubes with orange screw caps, all upright and capped; several appear to contain clear or colourless liquid, others look empty.

Along the rails sit white plastic squeeze/dropper bottles. Two stand upright in the middle with red conical caps in place, one marked with a blue band, the other with a green band. Several other white bottle caps or lids lie flat in their holder positions along the lower rails.

At the top rear are clear plastic pipette-tip racks and white trays.
observations: The description mentions white plastic squeeze bottles with green and blue bands, but there is no information regarding silicone containers or their arrangement.
